Name: Theo - Custom Romanceable NPC Mod
Author: Pepi69Peep
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This is my first attempt at modding so Theo [b]DEFFINETLY[/b] isn't perfect but I tried my best and plan on improving the mod in the future. There's [b][color=#a64d79]35 events[/color][/b] in total and over [b][color=#a64d79]200+ lines of dialogue[/color][/b]! I absolutely love making events so more might come in the future updates.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49983/49983-1785502315-1447230470.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49983/49983-1785502315-441058874.png[/img]
[color=#c27ba0](The [b]8 Heart[/b] event in town has few conditions I forgot to add in the picture:)[/color]
[b][color=#c27ba0]1) You have to be dating Theo.[/color][/b]
[b][color=#c27ba0]2) It needs to be a rainy day.[/color][/b]

[color=#ffffff]ok bye love you 🩷[/color]
[img width=163]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49983/49983-1785502362-1607427841.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Just drop the zip file into the mod manager.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Date a guy or something.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Huge thanks for MissCoriel for their NPC Creator app. It was massive help in learning how to make NPCs. I highly recommend it. (keep in mind the format has changed with the 1.6 SV update so make sure to follow the Modding wiki tips for that) [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4701]Miss Coriel's NPC Creator[/url][/color][/size]

Downloads.Description:
Theo Main File. Compatible for both vanilla and Stardew Expanded.

This version has a new Theo NPC id {{ModId}}_Theo so I recomend deleting or disabling the previous version of the mod and playing on a new save.
